title: Integrate the card-face fonts, adopt the Phosphor icon standard and render verified Lorcana symbols (D20–D22)
actor: Claude Code agent (architect/QA reviewer role) on Director request, local WSL session

changes.description: Card-face fonts (D20): The Bystander Collection Sans Regular, HvD trial Brandon Text Cond 400/400i/500/700/900i and Century Gothic Regular, byte-identical to the legacy originals, with checksums, source and embedded rights text in the font manifest. The trial Brandon builds cover 70 characters; Card Text Fallback (Source Sans 3 400/400i/500/700/900i; Medium, Italic and Black Italic added from the same 3.052R release) supplies every other character, measured by the new --cap-height mode of measure-font-metrics.mjs (size-adjust 106.06%, Brandon's typo metrics as overrides). measure-font-metrics.mjs now also reads WOFF2.

CardFaceText was its own size container, so its 6cqw padding resolved against the viewport and every printed cqw size shrank with the content box (title about 5 px in a 16rem card). An inner content box now carries the padding.

Interface icons (D21): @phosphor-icons/react 2.1.10 (MIT) pinned in packages/design-system; a curated 21-entry registry is the only Phosphor importer (one icon per import); Icon sizes standard 20 px and prominent 24 px; selected uses Fill. Selection controls keep 24 px through a new selection.size token; the icon stroke and size-small tokens are removed; the checkbox mark uses the registry.

Gameplay symbols (D21, D07): 12 official SVGs (6 inks unframed; lore, exert, inkable, uninkable, strength and willpower rules-text forms) vendored unchanged with a provenance manifest; scripts/symbol-lib.mjs parses a strict vector subset into src/generated/symbols.ts (drift-checked by tokens:check) with crops computed from shape bounds; GameSymbol component; InkIdentity shows the official ink symbol; DesignSystemProvider officialAssets={false} is the takedown switch to neutral placeholders.

Node: font provenance and rights basis for every file; Brandon coverage and fallback values recomputed from the files; icon-registry rule; symbol parser rejections; symbol provenance (34 design-system tests). Browser: icon and symbol sizes, Fill state, card fonts loaded with Chromium's per-node font report showing Brandon and the Source Sans 3 fallback, reading presentation in Brandon 20/28, official and neutral symbols, crop fit, forced colours, plus screenshots in both themes (161 tests). The browser suite now runs with font hinting off.
RUN-20261021-001 (configuration and workflow checks, pnpm audit clean, typecheck, lint, full suite: 403 Node, 26 Python, upstream 406/1 skip, 2 injection) passes at fingerprint 52f0e140.

RUN-20261021-002: isolated design-system suite passed in 117 s (34 gates, Chromium install, 161/161). RUN-20261021-003: isolated foundation pipeline passed all 14 stages in 571 s (488 Node, 26 Python, upstream 406/1 skip, 2 injection, 13 web Chromium, Lab workers).
